verdict.rationale: Source connections 'automatically sync data' on a recurring basis and webhooks fire when syncs complete, implying built-in recurring sync jobs, but there is no documentation of configurable scheduling (cron-like intervals), triggering multi-step workflows, or general job orchestration beyond data sync. Missing for 10: explicit scheduling/cron configuration API, documentation of workflow (multi-step) automation beyond sync, and independent confirmation that recurring jobs can be customized.
